set.body:
Not new work: a named ordering over beads that already exist, recommended by the third review over the plan's own P2 sequencing.

Prove the central contract end to end on a corpus ALREADY IN THE REPO before extending it across workbook formats:
  immutable verified artifacts  ->  verified sidecar parsing  ->  one existing Sherlock consumer
including the mutation tests.

That is: P1a (Raw/SourceCoordinate) + P2b-i (Verified from an enumerable store, IArray, copy-before-hash) + the sidecar-resolution bead + a thin slice of P5 (read timebase-repair.json and build a real ClockRepair).

Why this ordering: the plan's own riskiest slice is P2b-ii/P2c -- CorpusProfile plus open plus the real Friends run -- because that is where an unwritten profile format first meets 23 sheets of measured hazards, AND where 'profile as data under the data root, never in Git' means the synthetic fixtures and the real run cannot share a profile file. Doing Sherlock first establishes the contract where the data is already known and admitted.

Close this bead when the chain is green; it selects no new work of its own.
set.title: intake: THE RECOMMENDED FIRST SLICE -- verified artifacts to verified sidecar to one Sherlock consumer
